name: Prince William County Volunteer Fire and Rescue Junior Member Program

offerings.cycle_label: Ongoing junior membership at participating departments
offerings.summary: Some Prince William County volunteer fire departments take junior members from age 16, with all gear, uniforms and training provided free.

loc.venue: Participating Prince William County volunteer fire departments

age.raw: Some Volunteer Departments accept members into their Junior Member Program at age 16.

fee.raw: No, all required equipment, protective gear, uniforms, and training are provided to you at no cost.

sched.hpw_raw: Thirty volunteer hours a month (360 hours a year)
sched.dur_raw: Training completion one to three months depending on the member's ability to complete the training

app.instructions: Apply directly to individual volunteer departments; each has its own membership process

issues: The system page does not say which departments run a junior programme; students must contact departments individually
The 30 hours a month figure is published for volunteers generally and may not apply to junior members
